modules.name: Escarpo
modules.description: Clock swing, drift and burst. After Fragonard's The Happy Accidents of the Swing.

modules.name: Lillebror
modules.description: Three drum voices with wave morph and accent-shaped timbre. The little brother of Grids.

modules.name: Zenon
modules.description: Polymetric percussion: two 8-step tracks with their own length and destination drive a two-oscillator percussion voice. After Zeno's paradox of Achilles and the tortoise.

modules.name: Morel
modules.description: Records a moment, slices it by level and plays the slices from an 8-step sequencer, as hits or as grains. After Bioy Casares' The Invention of Morel.
